pos.text:
Idle Monster TD is an idle tower defense game built around the idea that you can’t truly lose. If enemies (the human‑robot hybrids) reach your center, the game simply rewinds 10–25 waves and auto‑replays the run. Logging in gives you offline rewards that can be spent on random monsters, upgrades, spell research or skill improvements. Active play still matters, though—random events require clicking, spells must be cast manually and upgrades don’t apply themselves.

The monsters are cute and mechanically distinct, with a mix of shared and unique abilities that either defend the tower, attack enemies or buff allies of the same attribute. I gravitated toward water monsters because of their strong freezing and slowing effects.

Early on, the game felt like a classic pay‑to‑win setup. I was getting wiped before wave 40, mostly because my roster was tiny, I could only place one copy of each

Idle Monster TD is a highly addictive combination of tower defense strategy and idle progression that manages to deliver far more depth than its simple presentation initially suggests. What starts as a fairly straightforward defense game about placing monster towers against incoming enemy waves slowly evolves into a complex system of elemental synergy, monster evolution, endless upgrades, and long-term optimization. The game succeeds because it balances passive progression with enough strategic decision-making to keep players constantly experimenting and refining their builds rather than simply watching numbers increase automatically.

The central gameplay revolves around summoning monsters to defend against endless waves of invading enemies. Each monster acts as a specialized tower with unique attack styles, passive abilities, and elemental properties that influence combat effectiveness

reviews.title: It’s a fun game
reviews.text:
I appreciate how they don’t have constant forced ads; rather it’s an optional ad that gives you a gift. The in app prices seem steep, but I see it as a necessity to help keep forceful ads at bay. Or you can just stay as a Free to play player. It’s a grind, but if you’re here, then that’s what you already want. An idle TD game that feels almost infinite, taking up 10 minutes of time or even hours. With a variety of ways to power up your monster using Essence or gems, also prestige points. You gain essence by beating every 10th level and from bosses I presume, my highest wave is only 190, so I’m still very new. Gems can be earned from completing challenges, while Prestige points can be amassed by going up in prestige. Also there are buyable bundles/packs of goodies. Good game.

Edit/tip: save up gems for 2x gameplay speed. It takes about two and a half days to earn 500 through achievements

reviews.text: So I just dowloaded this game yesterday and it’s very addicting. Only problem I have is that the the only thing you get while afk is gold. Now I know there are upgrades that minimize the amount of time needed for the ships and drones but the fact that you have to sit in game for like 12+ hours at least to get those upgrades is pretty ridiculous. This game is good but could be much, much better with one fix. Besides that the music, characters, and upgrade system along with other things make this game very good. reviews.title: Fun but needs more communication
reviews.text: I love the game and everything about it, the only thing I would like to see is maybe clans, some sort of communication box to talk to people, and maybe some sort of world boss level where the monsters are extremely hard and the boss at the end has more hp than most people can kill. The whole community could work to kill it and rewards given to the most damage and or clan damage. It just feels empty when getting on would like people to talk to. I would also like the function of it working levels while the game is closed. Skipping by 5 up to 75% of what you had before takes forever at late game and not everyone has time to have the game up for 3-5 hours a day. Other than those ideas the game is still entertaining.

I also like the different maps, but the one real issue I have is the game is more Idle Game than TD. Don’t get me wrong, it is fun and I am still playing it, but it is definitely not the best (hence the 4 star rating).  Also there is this bug where your tower has targeting of the “furthest in the maze” but sometimes they definitely do not shoot the furthest.  Overall

reviews.title: Good game but some deal breaking flaws for me
reviews.text: Overall it’s a decent TD game, I’ve played it consistently and for the most part it doesn’t seem like it’s locked behind micro-transactions to advance far. Buying gems will help accelerate you getting to higher waves but by no means are necessary to get their. The main issue I have with this game is how much time it takes to get to where you were after you prestige. I saved up 500 gems to get the 2x speed perk (all gems earned through playing which is nice) and even with the 2x speed this game takes forever once into the early 100 waves. This to me wouldn’t be an issue but in order to progress through waves you need to have the app open. The “idle” aspect of this game is you earn gold while not playing. If they made it so you could progress through waves with the game closed, like a true idle game, I would give it 5 out of 5 stars. Having to have this app open for 2 hours straight just t

reviews.title: Impressive Free2Play
reviews.text:
This game captures its name very well. The gameplay and visual elements of Idle, Monster and TD games are implemented so well together in harmony. 

What impresses me the most is the ad system of this game. Watching ads is not forced and does not feel like a chore if you do watch them. In fact, I want to watch the ads every time they are offered just because the rewards are so incentivizing. And the game is not paused during the ads, which is perfect for an idle game. I have never seen a game that can make ads feel good like this one. 

Overall, the gameplay experience is very unique and clearly well-thought in every aspect. No random feature thrown in just to squeeze out content and money like most other F2P games.

reviews.title: Great app but needs some small tweaks
reviews.text:
The app is great, and I love playing it with so much free time now, but there’s a couple things that can use adjusting. The app layout isn’t compatible with the iPhone 11 screen size, it’s a little big and the bottom menu buttons are too small to tap on. My hands are relatively normal size by the way. It’s even harder to tap on with the home button bar blocking over Collections, 
Premiums Shop, and Challenges buttons as well, so maybe some space at the bottom of the screen to avoid existing the app. Also the menu that pops up after you tap on a monster blocks other monsters on the bottom half of the screen and that can be annoying when leveling a monster up on the bottom half of the map. Other then that the app works great and I can’t get enough of it.

reviews.title: It’s okay
reviews.text: This game is cool in theory, and would be in practice, however there’s a problem that makes gameplay really difficult. Aside from the tournament timer, timers don’t countdown. Your spells/drone swarm/cargo carrier don’t refresh when you’re not in the game. This becomes a bit problematic since this is an idle game, a game that you don’t really need to have open all the time. The game also doesn’t progress while you are not in it. Waves of robots come, but if you’re not in the game, you don't go on to the next wave, you just sit there and collect money, which isn’t much in earlier waves. Overall i want to like this game. It’s really easy to not pay money, and if you do spend a little bit it can give a pretty good edge over the idle part of the game. However with the game not really working without you having the game open, it loses the “Idle” part of its name.

reviews.title: Not really idle and greedy as hell.
reviews.text:
I like idle games they are fun things to play during the day. This game isn’t really a idle game. Only way to make progress is having the app open at all times. The minute you close the app you stop making progress and make small amount of gold until you open it back up again.

On top of that is the greed. This app wants to charge you for everything. Now I don’t mind spending money on f2p games I usually do. But the prices here are insane and the amount of things to buy with real money, in game currency, and bundles are so over the top. There is even a tournament where people compete to get the highest completed wave and you can pay to boost damage or whatever in the tournaments. It’s shameless and expensive. Don’t bother with this game I tried it and wanted to love it but it’s just too many issues to fully enjoy it.

reviews.title: Ads and game pictures
reviews.text: lol I just wrote this and was looking at the pictures and the text they put on the images is incredibly wrong. They say defend your tower but you are defending a portal. They say evolve your monsters but there is no way to evolve them. You unlock new ones with currency you get. How do you not even know what is in your own game? This game itself is not bad. The funny part is you would think the part that makes them money they would make sure works. Just started playing and watched I want to say 3 level of ads so 15 and now almost every single ad is a black screen. I have to close and reopen the app and the floating treasure chest is gone. It's becoming tedious and to the point where  won't watch any other ads. So their way of making money won't make them any from me.

reviews.title: Glitch
reviews.text: Great game I would play it a lot last year and got really far. I just downloaded it again the other day and linked my progress to my phone and everything was there. Though, when i try to prestige a screen appears telling me Im going to Cursed Clouds; nothing happens. The white screen sits there. So i exit out of the app and go back in and im back. I received my prestige points but didn’t reset my progress. Sort of annoying because i cant get essence or make any real progress unless theoretically I prestiged constantly and got a lot better stats using the points. That would be cool but that’s not how you play the game. I hope someone can help me fix this glitch.

reviews.title: Found a Essenes bug
reviews.text: I had around 2100 Essenes I used 600 on an upgrade and I went down to 894 ish Essene now I’m know I’m not good with math but I know that’s not right😂 I don’t think it’s that big of a deal but a tournament is coming up and I want to be prepared the best since I’m very new to this game also, the game crashes every now and then but that might be because I’ve been on it for 2-3 days without getting off and I’ve had it for I think 3 1/2 to 4 days so I would love it if this doesn’t happen again but it’s a bug I’m sure other players are having as well, thanks.

reviews.title: Too slow, not enough player participation
reviews.text: Overall concept is good. The game just moves so slow. You just watch as monsters creep slowly along in waves that take forever to advance through. An ad can be watched to speed up the game but lasts for only 2 minutes. Eventually towers get expensive to upgrade and you do nothing but watch and wait for money to come in. Becomes incredibly boring. Restarting currency also does not go far enough. Spend hours upon hours to reach the respec point to get a handful of small upgrades and then do it all over again. Also in game purchases are poorly priced. No way I would spend what they are asking, it’s way too expensive for what would be received.

reviews.title: Tank you developers!
reviews.text: Great game, super addicting! It brings in strategic elements as well as the game is never just extremely tough in one part of the game like most other tower defenses but it just alway has this fluid motion to it, you’ll never get stuck in one place for too long which is why the game is so addicting. It also doesn’t just take everything in the game from other similar games because it has tons and tons of original content for hours of fun every day. Thank you for creating such a great game!

reviews.title: THIS GAME IS AMAZING
reviews.text: This is by far the best game I have downloaded in a long time. I’m always looking for tower defense type games to play that can last for a while. The game design is perfect and everything is explained clearly. Thank you so much to the creators for making a tolerable game with optional ads that actually help you out so I am compelled to watch them. Keep it up, this game should be what all game/app developers strive to achieve.  Well done indeed you should get this game.

reviews.title: Most of you misunderstand
reviews.text:
Literally. Like most of you one, two, or three-star this game because you don’t pay attention, lol. Hauler and drone timers DO count down while offline. RNG makes this game go ‘round. When one element starts doing better, focus on your best tower and diversify where you can because you will regret not doing so. Artifacts will eventually be the DRIVING FORCE behind pushing waves. That is all.

This is an amazing, long-lasting game that has yet to feel too grindy for me. I literally only rated four stars because it crashes a lot once I start hitting the 700th wave or so. 

Other than that loving the good work, thank you!

reviews.title: Ignore the Pay to win mechanics, it’s a great game.
reviews.text: I’m not a fan of the pay to win mechanics with the tournaments , but as for the base game it’s fantastic. I haven’t had an add shoved in my face unless I choose, gems are easy enough to come by that you don’t need to buy them, gold takes a while to accumulate once you get into the 500’s but gold control is the difficulty spike. Once your daily bonuses start coming in at higher amounts you’re able to make some headway though. 5/5 fun game for free.

reviews.title: i love this game
reviews.text: i just got this game earlier today and my highest wave count is already 159! i cant get enough of the BANGER soundtrack and cute monsters. the only thing i don't like is that for a while the rounds are easy and you just sit and wait while one monster destroys them all. i wish it was cheaper to increase the game’s speed. it costs 250 in-game gems i think, which is kinda a lot for just a small boost. that’s kinda it though! love this so much

reviews.title: Amazing game, even better developer!
reviews.text: I have never written a review on a game but this game made me feel like I had to. It’s impossible to not love this game and developer. You can tell they listen and take input from the people that play. I think if you enjoy any type of incremental game or progression over time, this is the game for you. While it is not necessary, join the discord! They are extremely friendly and help a lot!

reviews.title: Fun game, one major problem
reviews.text: So, this game is a lot of fun. The only problem is that you can’t progress waves while not in game. It takes FOREVER to get back to your previous wave after prestige. I don’t want to leave my phone on running this game for hours just to get back to where I was. If this one problem was fixed it would jump up to five stars. There are other, smaller things that I would like to see, like increasing gold earning as you progress through waves, but all are not as important as the one I mentioned earlier. It means that the game is not really idle.

reviews.title: Great Game, Addicting
reviews.text:
I don’t write reviews much, but this game is definitely fun. It has a nice nostalgia factor for me, and I love tower defenses. I enjoy how you get permanent buffs by watching ads, instead of temporary. The variant ways of in-game currency to buff things is nice too. While yes there’s things you can buy with real money, it’s still fun for me without spending any, and I’ve only been playing a couple of days. 
To anyone who enjoys the old-style tower defenses, this would be a good choice.

reviews.title: TO DEVELOPERS
reviews.text:
this game is awesome! so many options that keep you on your toes. beautiful design and cute complex monsters. and the fact that you can prestige makes it all the best. definitely worth the play and download. there are some small bugs though.

NOTE TO DEVELOPER: i clicked the cargo ship option and it isn’t spawning the cargo but i’ll receive the awards for my daily cargo spawn.. i really hate when it happens because i don’t get the loot (500k gold 150 green soul things) name in game : blaqheart

reviews.title: Pretty good actually
reviews.text:
Pretty decent tower defense game. It seems like I can progress pretty far without using real money for in game currency. It does seem like a little grind to get there, but that’s part of the fun. 
A few issues I’ve noticed:
After completion of a tournament, I didn’t seem to get any rewards that I should have gotten from my tier.
Also, sometimes it takes a while for the game to give me my idle away coins that I’ve earned.

reviews.title: Perfection
reviews.text: Honestly, I think everything about this game is great. The art style is executed well, the gameplay and strategy involved is good, and the process of collecting currency isn’t too slow or too fast. There are a lot of different upgrades and ways to upgrade your monsters. Each is one is unique and actually helpful towards your progress. 5/5 stars, good job.

reviews.title: Mediocre TD
reviews.text: Played this quite a bit and advanced to a pretty high level. Overall the game is fun for a week or so but gets incredibly repetitive and really offers very little replayability other than a constant grind. It’s not about synergy ore using the best towers, it’s simply a straightforward power level. Eventually you have to restart the game and repeat the process over and over. The game was fun for a while and once you’ve upgraded your skills, there is very little long term. Overall the pixel look is pretty good but there are much better tower defense games. Will say the game is fun for the week though!

reviews.title: Paid for gems and didn’t get them.
reviews.text:
So apparently there’s several places within the game to upgrade game speed. In fact I was pretty bummed to see that after realizing I could have bought a much more cost effective package. 

Either way, I purchased the permanent game speed increase in the settings section of the game (not realizing there were different ways to purchase this upgrade in a different section of the game menu). But in that section it said $9.99 for 2x game speed and 500 gems. 

Now either that means it was 500 gems OR $9.99 and i didn’t realize that (very badly marked) or I didn’t get my gems. Either is possible. Either way is a huge bummer considering I now missed out on other package deals where I could have gotten more for less because you allow people who just got the game to find multiple ways to purchase without knowing it. 

Happy to update the rating when and if this is resolved. The game is a fun vers

reviews.title: Hits all the marks
reviews.text:
This is an excellent addition to the idle genre. I have made many in app purchases and will continue playing, I just wish the screen wasn't stretched on the iPhone X/XS Max. It would be better to just set it to the iPhone 7/8 screen size, with black bars on the top and bottom. Also, the iPhone version appears to be missing the battlefield shortcut for Boss Rush Mode. Either that, or it's covered up by the notch on the X/XS Max.

Fix these things and it's 5 stars all the way!

reviews.title: Very addicting
reviews.text: I like this game a lot. It scratches quite a few of my gaming itches. It’s a great idler that I don’t have worry about all the time as well as a pretty decent tower defense with a lot more strategy than I thought there would be. The only things I don’t like are how there is only one monster of each element for each rank as well as the buttons at the bottom are very small and it’s difficult to click on them sometimes. Other than that I love this game!

reviews.title: The best idle game i’ve seen, great job!
reviews.text: They don’t have consistent ads for a start…🤣 so thank you so much. I’ve been playing for a few days and i adore this game, it’s simple, with an absolutely adorable art style, it’s original, it’s addictive, and super well made! 5/5 idle game, 5/5 tower game :D. Keep updating this game! It’s one of the best mobile games i’ve seen yet :)

reviews.title: Please remove ad information farming
reviews.text:
1. I won’t watch ads that require me to answer information about my age etc. Please offer an option to opt out of answering/skip answering if you’d like to collect as revenue from me.

2. Why am I penalized for purchasing an ad-free experience? Those who watch ads can time their bonuses to progress through waves but I’m forced to rely on luck to get a 2x damage buff near the limit of my progress? Boo.

reviews.title: Reccomed but I have a few issues
reviews.text: I really love this games but I have a problem with the speed of the game because you’re gonna be using prestige a lot and when you get on like wave 600 2x speed is not gonna cut and is gonna get really tiring and repetitive.I feel like the speed should be free and there should be 4x or up to 6x speed

reviews.title: Very Fun, Just a few improvements needed
reviews.text: Excellent idle and tower defense merger. Tons of different things to upgrade and ways to get stronger. Definitely easy to sink a lot of time into. Currently my only complaint is that some aspects of the game are not explained too well, but other than that it is fine. Also, enemies outside of just robots would be nice. So far good job though devs.

reviews.title: Awesome game, but not idle
reviews.text: I’m not sure what’s going on with the name or description of this game but it’s simply not true. The only way to progress at all is to have the app open. Once you close it it pauses everything. You get a bit of gold when you come back but once you reach higher levels and prestige, it literally will take hours just to get back to where you were before. If it actually would be idle it’d be a killer game. As it stands now, not worth the time.

reviews.title: Play this one
reviews.text: I’ve been looking for a game to pour some time into with everything being closed from COVID and this game is perfect. There’s tons of upgrades to keep yourself busy and you’re constantly unlocking more rewards. The people I’ve convinced to play have instantly become as addicted as I am. If you like tower defense and collection games you’ll like this.

reviews.title: Absolutely Love It
reviews.text: It’s a pretty nice idle game, I’m haven’t played enough tower defense games to compare but it seems like a relatively decent one. The monsters and enemies are designed well and I’m a huge fan of the art style and the gameplay loop is simple but enjoyable. Again, it’s more of a tower defense themed idle game if anything, but as an idle game it’s pretty nice.

reviews.title: Fun but greedy
reviews.text:
It’ll set you back $49 to unlock all boosts (double speed, double gold, etc). Every single aspect of the game is broken down and can be enhanced by a fee whether by real money or gems. To be nickel and dimed like this (in an idle game no less) is not fun. Which is a shame because the game itself can be fun. 

To charge this much is a slap in the face to AAA developers. Why spend $49 + unlimited on gems when you could spend $50 on something like The Last of Us 2? Are the devs valuing this little idle game the same as that? I sure as hell wouldn’t.

reviews.title: Not quite what I was looking for.
reviews.text: You would think with a game that says it’s idle it would actually be idle. But I see myself spending hours on this game just to progress through waves and to me that’s not what idle means. But yah it functions well enough. Also what’s up with the unreasonable pay to win options. 5bucks for like less than 50 essence. That’s a rip off To all the kids who fall for it.

reviews.title: Yo
reviews.text:
I love this! I rarely leave reviews, those constant in game review requests don’t even persuade me. I leave them when I’m feelin’ it. And I’m just straight up enjoying this!! 

Anyways, good mixture of a bunch of different genres that I like (Tower Defense being the primary one). I like the summoning of monsters mechanic. I’m on wave 80-ish right now. I’ll be dropping 10 bucks when I get paid.

reviews.title: Add more?
reviews.text: Overall the game is very good, no lag whatsoever, progressive gameplay, but it feels like there is a lack of monsters/towers to choose from, being there’s only 4 in each category. Besides that, the game is perfectly fine as is, but it would be cool to see some new towers or events in the game.

reviews.title: Really good, not perfect
reviews.text: There are a ton of free, but time-gated, ways to progress in this game. Overall, this game is pretty simple, enjoyable, and a good mix of tower defense and idle games. I just wish more of the permanent big ticket boosts where available for gems, instead of only the double game speed boost. But whatever, its still a solid game. Ill change this to 5 stars should they make all aspects of this game possible as a free player.

reviews.title: One specific thing that bothered me
reviews.text: Overall the game is pretty enjoyable, and I would recommend it. The only issue I have is that if you’re browsing the tech tree and click on the exotic monsters near the bottom, it lets you spend gems on the upgrades before you unlock the monster. And the mis-click lost me more than a hundred gems earned through gameplay.

reviews.title: I love the game, just have a suggestion
reviews.text: Hi I have been playing this game for a little over a year and I absolutely love it. I think it would be helpful if you guys added spell layouts just like you have for monster layouts. You can put it in the bottom left right next to the spells?

reviews.title: Hp seems pointless
reviews.text: Started the game with around 100 hp, seems like you gain more for killing robots, but no matter how much hp you have, you lose if even one robot gets through. I know this is an “idle” game but it’s also tower defense, dying from losing one life is utter nonsense. It would be a lot more fun to actually see the health depleting in a bad situation rather than “oops you lost let’s just start over”. This needs to be fixed, unless you’re telling me boss robots deal over 2,000 damage when they get through your portal

reviews.title: I love this game but I have one suggestion
reviews.text: I just started playing this game today I have 3 ultra rare monsters but it says evolution I know that you can collect grew up monsters like the fire bunny I love the fire bunny but maybe you could add more monsters like godly rarity monsters and they can evolve

reviews.title: Very good idle TD.
reviews.text:
I enjoy tower defense games, and idle games. 
This one uses both pretty well. 
What I absolutely love are the daily missions. 
There’s a lot, and they reward you with gems, a premium currency. 
This allows us, who are struggling financially during this pandemic, to enjoy some of the deeper mechanics of the game without dishing out money. 
The IAP are a bit pricy if you like to spend money, but as a F2P game, it’s not nearly as taxing on the free players then most free games. I really enjoy this aspect. 

Far as the game goes, I really like the monsters and their tie to the elements. Maybe a new element will come out later? Looking forward to see how this game grows!

reviews.title: “Idle” Game

reviews.title: P2W tournaments otherwise fun.
reviews.text:
So,.. first the game is interesting and fun to a small front. That being said there’s so much micro transactions that should be QOL in most games like this. 

Ad skipping? $5 (this is fine tbh)
DOUBLE AD REWARDS? $5
You want to increase wave speed/attack speed? $10
damage booster? $10
Gold booster? $10
RARER MONSTER DROP chances $15

Now to get to the pay to win aspects. There’re tournaments you can do,... these are allowed during tournaments,.. AND there is a tournament booster that can only be used PER tournament (which means buying it again if you want it again). It’s freaking $5 for 24 hours basically. 

I’m in the beginners bracket,... just started tournament that has run for two hours only. First person is on wave 190. 

Pay to win.

reviews.title: Simple but nice
reviews.text:
(1st thing) check out the wiki or discord, they have lots of tips. Discord even has events sometimes with packs and stuff given away for free. Really nice community. 
(F2P) F2P friendly, did seems a bit slow at first without game speed unlocks. I didn’t buy anything until I got to B10 in the tournaments and only spent $10. Wouldn’t go past b11 if you stay F2P.
(P2P) The prices seem high and some shop items pointless, but ADs are not thrown in your face. 
(Offline) This is not as Idle as the name suggest compared to other games, offline perks are pointless or just non existent in most areas. 
(New content) Has been decent on new content releases, but developer did go through a “difficult” process with IOS and Android for a bit, but seems to be back on content development now.
(Overall) Good game and easily able entertain you for a few weeks or longer if want something simple, but fun.

reviews.title: Money Scheme
reviews.text:
TLDR 
The game is interesting until you hit the paywall, and the paywall is literally the price of some console games. It would be a great game if it wasn’t so RNG cash hungry.

This game is pretty good in some areas, with a classic 8-bit art style and interesting tower designs that take interesting forms of animals.

However it becomes painfully clear around levels 30-40 that this is an extremely heavy grind game. 
You cannot replay levels, the game continues at its own pace. 
If you find yourself defeated the waves will reset from the last 10 waves, and the most important resource “essence” (which allows you to unlock spells and new towers) cannot be earned from replaying these waves.

reviews.title: Not my favorite
reviews.text:
Idle monster td 

It’s not really my favorite. I’ve been playing this for a couple days and nothing really sets it apart from other TD games. You have monsters in different classes like common and rare and ultra rare and so on and so forth, but a lot of the monsters in higher classes just look like evolutions of the monsters in the lower classes which I think isn’t very creative. If you’re going to make evolutions for the monsters, make evolutions for the monsters. Have evolutions for the common class, the rare class, ultra rare class, don’t just make evolutions and then spread them throughout the classes trying to pass them off as a completely different monster when they’re obviously an evolution of a lower class monster. It completely takes the mystery out of what you’re going to get in a higher class monster. You already know it’s gonna be a seahorse, just a meaner looking one than be

reviews.title: Really really like this game but make the circles actual circles
reviews.text: I really enjoy this game, i have fun every time I open the app and I’m hooked on it for hours. This is the first time I’ve actually gotten my mom hooked on a game that I told her to get. But I wish some of the “packs” that are offered in the game were cheaper. I got an offer for a “mythic” and “god” level monsters that cost $19.99. I don’t see myself paying that much in this game. Gems aren’t too hard to come by but not too easy.  Which I like the fact that I’m gaining them by not spending money. Last thing, can the circles ,in which the monsters stand in, be circular with out the pixilated effect? Please? As well as the range circle.
